I ran `/code-conventions --review-pr` against `d96f1ecef…HEAD` and found **no convention violations in the diff**. I went through all 60 rules in the checklist. The checklist was written to my scratchpad instead of `docs/engineering/`, because that path isn't in `.gitignore` here. I didn't modify any tracked files.

**What the diff contains:** one commit, `39baaa3d7 build(deps): resolve open dependabot advisories`. It touches `package.json` (+1/−1) and `yarn.lock` (+45/−74).
- `package.json:60` bumps `@nestjs/platform-fastify` from 11.1.28 to 11.1.29, still pinned to an exact version.
- The lockfile moves packages to newer versions within their existing ranges: brace-expansion, fast-uri, js-yaml 4.x, nanoid, postcss, tar and undici. It also merges duplicate entries for find-my-way, postcss and undici into one each.
- The Nest bump also pulls in fastify 5.11.0, @fastify/cors 11.3.0 and find-my-way 9.7.0 (`yarn.lock:1634-1660`).

## Rules that applied

| Rule | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| CONFIG-04: runtime deps pinned exactly | Pass | `package.json:60` is pinned exactly (`11.1.29`, no `^`). It now matches `@nestjs/common` and `@nestjs/core` at 11.1.29 (`package.json:57,59`) and `@nestjs/testing` (`package.json:95`). |
| CHANGE-01: smallest correct change | Pass | Only one line changes in `package.json`. Everything else is lockfile resolution. No overrides are added to `resolutions` (`package.json:120-122` is unchanged). |
| CHANGE-02: no unrelated edits | Pass | Nothing outside the dependency files changes. |
| CONFIG-05: env/tool metadata matches runtime | Pass | No change to the toolchain, Docker, CI or `.env.sample`. |
| PR-02: docs match behaviour | Pass | No docs are affected. The commit body explains why the js-yaml 5.2.1 advisory is left open: `@nestjs/swagger` 11.4.6 pins it exactly (`yarn.lock:1721`). |
| License headers | Not applicable | No source files change. |

The other 54 rules (modules, types, auth, routes, DB, cache, tests, logging, security, resilience, and so on) don't apply to a dependency-only diff. I didn't need to look up the review history behind any rule.

## Findings

**Blocking: none.**

**Notes (not violations, no action needed for this PR):**

1. **Peer range at `yarn.lock:1649`.** `@nestjs/platform-fastify` 11.1.29 now declares `@fastify/static: ^10.1.2`. The installed `@fastify/static` 10.1.3 (`package.json:53`, `yarn.lock:797`) satisfies it, and 11.1.28 declared `^8 || ^9`, so this bump fixes a peer mismatch. A mismatch that was already there remains: `@nestjs/serve-static` 5.0.5 still declares `^8.0.4 || ^9.0.0` (`yarn.lock:1699`), which 10.1.3 doesn't satisfy. `ServeStaticModule` is used in `src/app.module.ts`. This PR didn't cause it.
2. **Older CONFIG-04 exceptions at `package.json:52-53`.** `@fastify/cookie` (`^11.1.1`) and `@fastify/static` (`^10.1.3`) use caret ranges instead of exact pins. They're unchanged by this diff, so they're out of scope. At most they're a follow-up.
3. **Commit wording.** The commit body says it will "lift the transitive resolutions". That could be read as adding Yarn `resolutions` entries, but none were added: the upgrades are lockfile-only, within existing semver ranges. If this text becomes the PR body, "re-resolve transitive dependencies in yarn.lock" would say it more clearly.

**Unresolved rule failures or questions: none.**
